Plenty of reasons why the existence of this policy doesn't invalidate the article.

items.title: Rental Inspections and cleaning
items.text:
Rental Inspections and cleaning
We've been our place for a couple of months now and the real estate have notified us they're coming around to do an inspection. The email from the agent states "To ensure that the routine inspection is a success with positive feedback we encourage you take a moment to ensure that you have cleaned the following areas:" and then basically lists what I would consider to be an end of lease clean, not just general tidyness. Are they allowed to come in and inspect the cleanliness of the place beyond anything that is causing damage? Just a bit concerned as we think the real estate might have gotten a bit shitty as we have been bypassing them lately and going direct to the owner via his business manager for anything we need and have only spoken to the real estate to sort out their mistakes.
Out of office reply set and ready, bring on 5pm and 10 sweet sweet days off work
Beer and an uber
